G09:M000.reason: El japonés reconoce al chocobo, no pregunta por un objeto.

G09:M002.text: Wh... why is a Chocobo here?
G09:M002.reason: Conserva sorpresa y pregunta sobre el personaje.

G09:M009.text: There is a Book here, a rare treasure!
G09:M009.reason: Conserva descubrimiento del libro como tesoro.

G09:M011.text: Books start weak, then grow as you read.
G09:M011.reason: Gramática y progresión causal del uso de libros.

G09:M012.text: It is getting late. Be careful down there!
G09:M012.reason: Restituye despedida y advertencia por la hora.

G09:M015.reason: 降りてきただけって: no simple visita casual.

G09:M024.text: Got your Talons and Saddle equipped?
G09:M024.reason: Instrucción de equipo y término Talons del glosario.

G09:M025.text: They only help when you equip them!
G09:M025.reason: Referente plural Talons y Saddle, función de equipar.

G09:M030.text: It raises the level of Talons and Saddles.
G09:M030.reason: Unifica el término de equipo, antes Claws.

G09:M039.text: Fuse two Talons or two Saddles.
G09:M039.reason: Explicación funcional de fusión del japonés.

G09:M043.text: I finally found a pearl, but I dropped it.
G09:M043.reason: せっかく見つけたのに: contratiempo tras hallazgo.

G09:M044.text: Oh well. I will find another.

G09:M053.reason: Además de la perla, se presenta la magia.

G09:M059.text: Now that is a rare item!
G09:M059.reason: これこそ: deíctico enfático, no conclusión causal.

G09:M060.text: Oh, do you call unusual items rare items?
G09:M060.reason: Pregunta por la denominación, no tesoros en general.

G09:M062.text: You should not go too deep into the dungeon.

G09:M063.text: Do not overdo it. Return to the village!
G09:M063.reason: Restituye regreso a la aldea y condición de seguridad.

G09:M070.text: I was taking it out when a monster appeared. It got scared and ran off somewhere.
G09:M070.reason: Corrige agente, encuentro y huida del hámster.

G09:M079.text: Then spread your feathers a little more.
G09:M079.reason: 羽根を広げて: indicación física.

G09:M081.text: Now your feather bag holds a few more items.
G09:M081.reason: Conserva aumento moderado y ubicación de la bolsa.

G09:M083.text: Then I will take him up to the surface.
G09:M083.reason: 地上へ: a la superficie, no salida genérica.

G09:M086.text: This came from {Doru}, the Djungarian hamster.
G09:M086.reason: ドル君/Doru-kun en el original; Chip era otra entidad. Romanización provisional.

G09:M087.text: He sent it to thank you for rescuing him.
G09:M087.reason: Restaura agente: el hámster encargó entregar el objeto.

G09:M089.text: Blow it and {Doru} will bring you an item. It comes from {Atla's Dresser}.
G09:M089.reason: El consumidor menciona al mismo ドル君; no Chip.

G09:M097.reason: 思ったのに: expectativa truncada al cambiar el peligro a Atla.

G09:M108.text: See you. My identity is a secret.
G09:M108.reason: Corrige error gráfico de spelling; conserva misterio.

G09:M117.text: I see. The {furnace} is powering up!
G09:M117.reason: Restituye certeza tentativa y cambio del horno.

G09:M121.text: I should tell {Rask} about this too.
G09:M121.reason: Krehl habla en primera persona sobre avisar a Rask.

G09:M135.text: Come on. Let us go home.
G09:M135.reason: 帰るのさ: acción de regresar, omitida en inglés.

G09:M141.text: So he really is a good guy.
G09:M141.reason: 本当はイイヤツ: afirmación, no pregunta.

G09:M142.text: A lot happens when you are with him, huh?
G09:M142.reason: いろいろある: experiencias, no pregunta sobre la relación.

G09:M151.text: I came to give you this!
G09:M151.reason: Corrige la inversión tipográfica I'm y tono de la frase.

G09:M159.reason: 鉢植え: maceta, no planta nueva confirmada.

G09:M163.text: The Tyrian Crystal absorbs people. Their wishes form dungeons.
G09:M163.reason: Cadena causal y sujeto del original.

G09:M168.text: It bursts, sending copies across the world.
G09:M168.reason: 分身: copias del cristal, información omitida.

G09:M172.text: I sought it before it took anyone else.

G09:M177.text: You care about {Atla}, but like these items too?
G09:M177.reason: Conserva interés por Atla y curiosidad por objetos.

G09:M185.text: Lately I forgot what that duty was.
G09:M185.reason: Matiz temporal y memoria del deber.

G09:M186.text: Someone's heart was twisted by the crystal. I am that heart's cry for help.
G09:M186.reason: El hablante es la petición de ayuda misma, no sólo un corazón corrupto.

G09:M187.text: I can go between the dungeon and the surface. But I cannot fight.
G09:M187.reason: 戦うことはできない: incapacidad de combatir, no debilidad genérica.
pages: I can go between the dungeon and the surface.

G09:M188.text: My duty is to seek someone who can help.
G09:M188.reason: 探すコト: búsqueda de auxilio.

G09:M189.text: I help you find those needing rescue.
G09:M189.reason: No pide que el jugador lo saque del calabozo.

G09:M192.text: {Atla} is asking you to save him. My role is to help you do that.
G09:M192.reason: Corrige inversión grave de rescatador y rescatado.
pages: {Atla} is asking you to save him.
My role is to help you do that.
